items.name: SpawnedTask
items.summary: Helper that  provides a simple API to spawn a single task and join it. Provides guarantees of aborting on `Drop` to keep it cancel-safe. Note that if the task was spawned with `spawn_blocking`, it will only be aborted if it hasn't started…

methods.name: join
methods.summary: Joins the task, returning the result of join (`Result<R, JoinError>`). Same as awaiting the spawned task, but left for backwards compatibility.

methods.name: join_unwind
methods.summary: Joins the task and unwinds the panic if it happens.

methods.name: join_unwind_mut
methods.signature: async fn join_unwind_mut(&mut self) -> Result<R, JoinError>
methods.summary: Joins the task using a mutable reference and unwinds the panic if it happens.

methods.name: poll
methods.signature: fn poll(Pin<&mut self>, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<Self::Output>

methods.signature: fn spawn<T>(task: T) -> Self where T: Future<Output = R> + Send + 'static, R: Send

methods.signature: fn spawn_blocking<T>(task: T) -> Self where T: FnOnce() -> R + Send + 'static, R: Send
